summary: Myseum.AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: MYSE) filed an 8-K furnishing a September 23, 2026 press release announcing its intent to apply to tokenize its Nasdaq-listed common stock through one or more qualified digital-asset securities platforms. No price, stake or consideration terms were disclosed; the initiative is issuer-authorized, would represent actual registered shares rather than synthetic exposure, and would preserve economic, voting and ownership rights. The filing states no new security issuance, no capital-structure change and no offer; MYSE continues trading on Nasdaq, shareholders need take no action, and approval and implementation remain contingent.
